leadText: Sumire Morohoshi (Japanese: 諸星すみれ Morohoshi Sumire) is a Japanese voice actress for .
plainText:
Sumire Morohoshi (Japanese: 諸星すみれ Morohoshi Sumire) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Morohoshi was born on April 23, 1999, in , , and became a voice actress as a child. She joined at the age of 14, during ; she voiced the Douse Drive Genesect in the sixteenth movie. After a years-long absence, she went on to regularly voice Acerola during . Morohoshi is currently affiliated with the theatrical company .
